philippines.title: Asian Games 2026: South Korea beats Japan for men's basketball gold
philippines.description:
READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 South Korea defeated the home team Japan 67-57 for the men’s basketball gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Sunday.
